response.sql:
SELECT AVG(rating_avg_length) AS avg_of_rating_avg_lengths, AVG(rating_avg_ratio) AS avg_of_rating_avg_ratios
FROM (
  SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS rating_avg_length,
         AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS rating_avg_ratio
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
) AS per_rating;

assumptions.assumption: Each rating is weighted equally in the final averages, and SQL AVG ignores NULL lengths and ratios within each rating and among the resulting per-rating averages.
